title: Done
html_source:
Done is reminiscent of a musical instruction or direction from a conductor. The prelude is finished. Joyce’s intention for this construction are still being debated.

PROPOSED SUGGESTION: Reference to Robert Emmet’s speech from the docks : “ When my country takes her place among the nations of the earth, then, and not till then, let my epitaph be written. I have done”
